title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go and parity v1.158.2
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: SDK users reported subtle differences between Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs around auth token refresh, retry/backoff ergonomics, and streaming API signatures which made cross-platform integrations error-prone. This PR standardizes behavior, improves defaults, and bumps SDK parity to v1.158.2. Changes include: 1) unified auth token refresh hooks and default credential chaining with clear override points; 2) consistent retry policy implementation (exponential backoff with jitter, default max retries = 3, idempotency awareness for non-idempotent endpoints); 3) streaming API ergonomics: consistent iterator/callback semantics, cancelation propagation, and backpressure hints in all three SDKs; 4) parity fixes for Python/TS/Go method names and error classes; 5) version bumps and changelog updates. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - ENG-2045; - [x] unit tests for auth and retry paths in Python/TS/Go; - [x] e2e streaming smoke tests; - [x] docs and examples updated; - [x] CI green and approvals. Backwards compatibility: default behaviors preserved where possible; opt-in flags provided for teams that rely on older retry semantics. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut SDK patch releases v1.158.2 for Python/TS/Go, monitor error rates and streaming latencies via Redwood Console 24h after release.
